resource: Gold of one bank withdrawal (BANK-0 §4.2): at most 3 output stacks
allocation_impact: Checked before any read: an amount outside 1..=1,009,999 is INVALID_INPUT and writes nothing. The coins are the canonical split (crystal, platinum, gold, each at most 100), at most 3 new stacks; no room refuses the whole withdrawal (NO_ROOM).
boundary_tests: max=1,009,999 withdraws 100 crystal, 99 platinum and 99 gold
max+1 is refused before any write
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/bank.rs (bank writer: checked before any ledger entry, coin line, balance change or event; a typed refusal or error writes no value)
notes: BANK-0 §8 (owner answers 1b and Q1 b; ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §1.8 and §2.4); registered by BANK-1 before the code that relies on it.
